patterns: APPSC asks 'which Act' one-liners: GG of Bengal -> GG of India = Charter Act 1833; indirect election = 1892; dyarchy in provinces = 1919.
Match-the-list of Act vs feature (separate electorate 1909, dyarchy 1919, federation 1935, budget discussion 1892) is a recurring APPSC shape.
Traps: Regulating Act did not abolish Court of Directors; 1813 kept tea/China monopoly while 1833 ended trade; central dyarchy and federation never implemented.
Other-PSC staples: bicameral centre 1919, PSC 1919/1926, residuary powers with GG (1935), ordinance power relic of 1935, power distribution based on 1935 Act.
App MCQs are mostly multi-statement items with fine details (sections/schedules, 1767/1781 Acts) and a few off-topic polity items; APPSC prefers direct single-fact items.
